description: Use when the user wants two-arm Phase 2/3 sample size with a CONTINUOUS primary endpoint — change from baseline in a measured score (HAM-D-17, PANSS, HbA1c reduction, eGFR slope, BP), QoL scale, biomarker level. Provide mean_diff (assumed treatment - control mean) and the common within-arm sd. Set comparison='superiority' (default), 'non-inferiority' (provide ni_margin), or 'equivalence' (provide equiv_margin; fixed-sample only). Set design_class='group-sequential' for interim analyses with alpha-spending. Supports the same `operational` block as design_binary and design_survival. For multi-endpoint designs, use design_co_primary.

alpha.description: Type I error rate. For a standard two-sided 0.05 test use 0.025 with sided = 2.

comparison.description: Hypothesis type. 'superiority' (default) tests for a difference; 'non-inferiority' requires ni_margin; 'equivalence' requires equiv_margin.

design_class.description: Design class. 'fixed' = single final analysis; 'group-sequential' = interim looks with alpha-spending. Group-sequential params (k, timing, sfu/sfl, test_type) are ignored when design_class = 'fixed'.

k.description: Number of planned analyses including the final one. Integer in [2, 10].

ni_margin.description: Non-inferiority margin on the mean-difference scale.

operational.description: Optional operational kernel inputs. Supply any 0-4 of {accrual_rate, accrual_duration, follow_up_duration, total_trial_duration}; the solver fills in the missing values from rate*duration = N and A + F = T (plus target_events for survival). Result is attached as result.operational with audit fields (given, derived). Supply max_n and/or max_duration to surface feasibility warnings rather than silently returning a design that violates user-stated caps.

max_duration.description: Optional total-trial-duration cap (months). Same warning shape as max_n. Useful when the trial has a hard business deadline that the design must respect.

max_n.description: Optional sample-size cap. If the design exceeds it, a structured feasibility_warnings entry is attached to result.operational explaining the over-by-X% gap. Does NOT change the design — the agent uses the warning to suggest tradeoffs (relax effect size, raise the cap, accept reduced power).

power.description: 1 - beta. Targeted power of the test (default 0.9).

sfl.description: Alpha-spending function. OF = O'Brien-Fleming, Pocock = Pocock, HSD = Hwang-Shih-DeCani (needs sfupar), Power = power family (needs sfupar), LDOF / LDPocock = Lan-DeMets approximations (the standard), 'none' disables.

sfu.description: Alpha-spending function. OF = O'Brien-Fleming, Pocock = Pocock, HSD = Hwang-Shih-DeCani (needs sfupar), Power = power family (needs sfupar), LDOF / LDPocock = Lan-DeMets approximations (the standard), 'none' disables.

sided.description: 1 = one-sided test (default), 2 = two-sided. Many modern designs use sided = 1 with alpha = 0.025 to match the two-sided 0.05 convention.

test_type.description: gsDesign test.type. 1 = efficacy-only, 2 = symmetric efficacy+futility, 3 = non-binding futility, 4 = binding futility, 5/6 = same with lower beta-spending.

timing.description: Information fractions at each analysis, length k, strictly increasing in (0,1], last = 1. Defaults to equal spacing 1/k, 2/k, ..., 1.

name: design_continuous
